answer: The lantern register is checked at draw time, pulse lists the eligible set, and sparrow seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 26 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an copycat pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 26 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Honest users pay that once, farms 36 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
